name: Kailyn A.
text: I signed up for the broom making class on my first trip to Salem this summer. Not only was the class unique, but I felt like I was able to take in the whole experience without being rushed, with a fun souvenir to take home! Santiago was my instructor. He was incredibly helpful, encouraging throughout the whole experience, and even offered some recommendations for other things to do during our visit. Highly recommend this experience to anyone visiting for the first time!

name: Christina D.
text: My two best friends and I had an absolute blast making brooms at the Witch City Broom Making Workshop! The instructors were so much fun and made it easy to learn how to make our beautiful brooms. It was so worth every penny to have this experience!

name: Julia G.
text: My daughter and I made brooms this year on our trip! What a wonderful experience. The class and team were helpful, encouraging and didn't rush the process. Plus added bonus, they packaged and mailed our brooms for a very reasonable fee. Will definitely be back next year.

name: Elisa P.
text: My grandma and I took a broom making class together led by Ashley. She was incredible, and we lucked out being the only ones, so she made it extra special for us. It was the perfect souvenir, made with love and captured the essence of our time in Salem. If I could give 100 stars I would!

name: Sheila R.
text: We had such a good time making brooms with Santiago! There is a lot of cool stuff in Salem but this was my favorite part of our visit.

name: Kaitlyn P.
text: Highly recommend! I am not a crafty person, but this class did a step by step instruction on how to make a broom and it turned out wonderful! Shout out to Emily! She helped me craft the perfect broom and was patient with me. She is the best!!

name: Erin B.
text: The Witch City broom making workshop was absolutely magical! Samantha and Michelle were so wonderful, 10/10 recommend! Just make sure to book early!

name: Mike M.
text: I surprised the wifey for her birthday as she has never been to Salem before. She had an absolute blast making her own witches broom. The instructor was amazing and I highly recommend doing this!

name: Kristina S.
text: Doing one of their broom making classes was INCREDIBLE! I booked a slot and met Mel at the broom making shop, separate from the shop on Essex. She made the whole broom making class a blast with not only the whole broom making process, but her vast knowledge about Salem and the witch trials. She answered all my questions and taught me so much! I will definitely be returning to make another broom. Thank you Mel! You rock!

name: Christiana S.
text: I absolutely loved the broom making workshop I attended! The instructors were friendly, helpful, and made it a fun experience. I recommend this broom making experience in Salem over others due to the cozy environment, intention put into each class, and everything included in the pricing. They also offer shipping on site, which I took advantage of!

name: Sarah L.
text: Hilary was an amazing host for our broom making session! She was very friendly and professional when speaking about the different meanings in the practice of binding, colors, and arrangements for the brooms. If you do anything in Salem, this should be at the top of your list! We are excited to hang our brooms in the houses!

name: Denise G.
text: So much fun selecting the materials to make our own brooms which encompassed our individuality & creativity. Staff was exceptionally helpful to assist us especially with securing the broom corn. What a phenomenal experience to share with family & friends during this spooky season in Salem!!

name: Launa S.
text: The broom making class with Melisandre was a highlight of my trip! She was so knowledgeable, kind, helpful and patient. I highly recommend this experience!!

name: Krystin S.
text: We had the BEST experience making our own brooms with Ashley, she was incredible and the experience was so much fun!

name: Kenzie G.
text: We had the best time making our brooms with Ashley. She was patient and took her time teaching us. She was great!

name: Bryan M.
text: So much fun! Ashley and Diane were the best instructors and made the whole process so enjoyable. This is a must do!

name: Jessie S.
text: Did the broom making workshop with Mel! She's incredible and it was so much fun! Absolutely recommend!
